thread:
ava: Quick postmortem follow-up for RDI-4021: we need owners + short deadlines for the regression artifacts so follow-ups can be closed.
samir: I'll own the CI regression job and the triage rotation doc. Plan: create `ci-eval/regression-smoke` (<=30s) and a nightly `ci-eval/regression-full`.
kelly: I'll author the prompt-set group (fallback role-tokenization + stop-seq) and a tiny repro that CI can run. Will put examples under `suites/regression/fallback_role_tokenization.json`. Target: PR in 3 days.
sanjay: I'll take the chaos drill (fallback + node drain) and the load profile. Proposed traffic: steady 200 rps, 60s spike to 800 rps, drain 1 GPU at t+95s. I'll add abort criteria (error rate >2% or stop-seq fail rate >0.5%).
eval-bot: Created task RDI-5200 (ci-regression + rota) assigned to samir, due 2026-04-03.
kelly: Minimal prompt example I'll add:
```json
[{"id":"fb-001","prompt":"role: user\ncontent: Repro text that forces fallback","assert":"token_role_consistency"}]
```
samir: Rotation suggestion: eng-ml weekdays 09:00-18:00, eng-platform nights/weekends. I'll draft a one-pager and attach to RDI-5200. Also adding a `regression-needs-triage` label that CI toggles on failure.
sanjay: k6 spike snippet for the chaos ticket (will include in runbook):
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function(){
  http.post(__ENV.GEN_URL, JSON.stringify({prompt: 'role:user\\ncontent: load test'}), {headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}})
}
```
eval-bot: Created task RDI-5201 (chaos drill: fallback + node drain) assigned to sanjay, due 2026-04-10.
kelly: I'll also add a stop-seq unit check that asserts no truncation and a top-k distribution check. CI badge should fail on any regression.
ava: Eval harness changes needed: KV warmup, top-k distribution metric, canary gate that blocks promotion on regression. Who picks that up?
eval-bot: RDI-5202 (eval-harness: KV warmup + metrics + canary gate) created and assigned to kelly, due 2026-04-06.
kelly: I'll implement the harness hooks and the dashboard alert when top-k shifts >5% over 30m. Also will wire the CI canary gate to fail deploys on regression.
samir: When CI flags regression, the on-call should run the triage checklist: 1) collect failing prompts, 2) capture model variant + KV state, 3) run the small repro locally, 4) escalate to owner if not flaky. I'll put that in the rota doc.
sanjay: I'll schedule a dry-run with SRE for 2026-04-09 and capture artifacts back to the postmortem ticket.
ava: Recap owners/dates: samir - ci jobs + rota (due 2026-04-03), kelly - prompt-sets + harness + canary (due 2026-04-06), sanjay - chaos drill + runbook + dry-run (due 2026-04-10). I'll update the RDI-4021 follow-ups with these ticket links after RDI-5200/5201/5202 are created.
eval-bot: Tasks RDI-5200, RDI-5201, RDI-5202 created and linked to RDI-4021.
ava: Thanks all. If anything slips, comment in the ticket and @ava so we can reprioritize. :thumbsup:
